sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Move nltl:loadingConditionIdentifier off gen:LoadingConditionCaseShape and constrain it on the authoritative required owner, nltl:ship. Also replace the exact sh:minInclusive/sh:maxInclusive 1 equality on the derived residualStabilityFactorSI numeric value with a bounded tolerance comparison scaled from expected result 1; retain unit:UNITLESS and enforce the comparison for the applicable loading-condition result context.

Repair the per-loading-condition model: nltl:loadingConditionIdentifier has canonical domain loadingConditionCase but is currently constrained on the ship; constrain it on each nltl:hasLoadingConditionCase value instead. Ensure the standard s_i route and the alternative-instrument route are evaluated for each identified loading-condition case, with the required case-to-evidence relationship enforced where the alternative route is selected; the current graph only requires a ship-level identifier and does not bind the per-case condition/evidence structure to the corresponding compliance alternative.

Replace the residualStabilityFactorSI numeric tolerance (0.999999 to 1.000001) with exact inclusive bounds: sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive both "1"^^xsd:decimal. The regulatory s_i value is an exact constant, not a derived formula result eligible for tolerance.
